title.narrative: Enhancing the concept of education for sustainable development among workers in the local development directorates of the municipalities of southern, central and northern Jordan

description.narrative: Since Jordan was invited to present its country initiative for education for sustainable development, the Jordan National Commission for UNESCO/Education Sector began forming a national team for education for sustainable development to prepare the initiative with the five areas of work identified by UNESCO: (strengthening policy, transforming learning environments, building teachers’ capacities, empowering and mobilizing youth, and accelerating actions at the local level). Therefore, we found it advisable to work on implementing a training project in the fifth field: accelerating measures at the local level through municipalities in all governorates of the Kingdom, where directors of local development directorates in municipalities will be trained to enhance their awareness of sustainable development issues and to demonstrate the importance of their role in achieving SDGs 2030
